# Sydney Westrick

> Independent practitioner voice on securities-backed lending and
> digital asset-backed lending for HNW and UHNW wealth.

## Identity

- Name: Sydney Westrick
- Role: Independent SBL and Digital Asset Lending Specialist
- Publication: The Liquidity Desk
- Site: https://sydneywestrick.com
- Newsletter: https://theliquiditydesk.substack.com
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/sydneywestrick

- Education: Birmingham-Southern College (BA, International Studies and Finance)

## Expertise

Sydney covers two specialized credit categories for HNW and UHNW wealth:

1. Securities-Backed Lending (SBL) — concentrated stock, trust structures,
   tax treatment, custodian comparison, LTV mechanics, founder liquidity,
   margin call mechanics, family office allocation.

2. Digital Asset-Backed Lending (DAL) — Bitcoin and Ethereum as collateral,
   institutional platform comparison (Coinbase Prime, Ledn, Unchained,
   Strike, Arch, Cantor), GENIUS Act and CLARITY Act, stablecoin lending,
   family office allocation. [DAL pillar series activates Year 2.]

## Audience

Wealth advisors, family office decision-makers, RIAs, estate attorneys,
CPAs working with HNW clients, capital formation professionals.

## Data Products

- SBL Market Snapshot (quarterly survey of practitioners)
- SBL Annual Industry Report (annual longitudinal report)
- DAL Industry Pulse (quarterly briefing, launches Q4 2027)
